encodings.reduced: selector a = the pair's first qubit, data d = its second; reduced two-label LCU with CNOT as H CZ H on d; setting X adds H on d and setting Y adds Sdag, H on d before the measurement; CZ depth n repeats CZ(a, d) (n - 1) times after the SELECT CZ, each after a per-qubit barrier run
encodings.walk: control c and the data bits on the layout's data qubits in ascending bit order; CNOT as H CZ H on the data qubit; omega as Z on c after its first H; readout Y adds Sdag on c before its last H
encodings.readout: readout-0 measures all 17 qubits in |0>, readout-1 after X on all 17

preregistered.observable: per LCU replica the selector success P(a = 0) and, for every populated selector branch b, the data expectation E_b = <S_d | a = b> = 2 P(d = 0 | a = b) - 1 in the replica's setting S (X: H on d; Y: Sdag, H on d); per walk the control expectation 2 P(c = 0) - 1, which reads <X_c> (readout X) or <Y_c> (readout Y: Sdag, H on c)
preregistered.design: seven batches in FOLLOW_PLAN order. lcu-{bright,dark}-{x,y}-{1,2}: 2 x 2 crossovers in which the edge (1,10)(4,15) of kite 3 at y_sign y and its census twist (4,10)(1,15) of kite 6 at -y trade the pairs (1, 4) and (10, 13) between circuits 1 and 2; (12, 14) holds the edge at both signs in the bright block and the strut (1,10)(2,9) at both signs in the dark block. depth-{5,9}-{x,y}: the bright edge at that CZ depth on all three pairs. walk-x, walk-omit, walk-y: the kite 1 exemplars (2,11,3) on star 14 {11, 12, 16} (6 CZ) and (2,3,10) on path 4 {1, 2} (4 CZ), read in X, with the last block omitted, and read in Y
preregistered.readout: readout-0 and readout-1 in batches 0, 3 and 6; each qubit's e01 and e10 at a witness job are interpolated linearly in job finish time between the two nearest brackets, with the binomial variance of both brackets; the bracket difference enters as a reported systematic. Pc = (p - e10) / (1 - e01 - e10) on the selector; E_b inverts the tensor product of the selector's and the data qubit's assignment matrices on the joint (a, d) counts
preregistered.classification: D = Pc(y_sign -1) - Pc(y_sign +1) per row and pair, pooled over the settings: D above +0.4 same-sign (twist), below -0.4 opposite-sign (edge), |D| below 0.2 strut, otherwise unresolved; a misclassified or unresolved row refutes the separation of its pair
preregistered.twist: per block (bright: edge +, twist -; dark: edge -, twist +) and setting, Delta = [(Pc(edge, pair 0, circuit 1) - Pc(twist, pair 0, circuit 2)) + (Pc(edge, pair 1, circuit 2) - Pc(twist, pair 1, circuit 1))] / 2, in which the pair and circuit offsets cancel; the census predicts Delta = 0, and |Delta| above 3 standard errors refutes twist equality for that block and setting. The edge and the twist differ only in their local Z, S and Sdag gates, so a refutation measures a gate-dependent error between them
preregistered.strut: D of the strut on (12, 14) per setting; |D| above 0.1 + 3 sigma exposes a pair-dependent bias
preregistered.coherence: census predictions: E_0 = -1 on the bright edge and twist in X, E_1 = +1 on the dark edge and twist in X, 0 in Y and 0 on both strut branches. Falsifier: an X expectation of sign opposite to the census at |z| > 3, or a strut |E_b| above 0.1 + 3 sigma. Cross-prediction: the depth-1 magnitude |E_b| in X equals T0's C(1) = 0.954 within 0.1, the value a depolarizing error of the two-qubit block gives
preregistered.depth_ladder: per pair, the bright edge at CZ depths 1 (the lcu-bright circuits), 5 and 9 gives the magnitude m(n) = sqrt(E_X^2 + E_Y^2), the phase phi(n) = atan2(E_Y, -E_X) about the census value -1, and the population Pc(n) of the same replicas; r_coh and r_pop are exp(slope) of ln m(n) and ln Pc(n) on n, and the phase slope is phi per CZ, each with a 99% parametric-bootstrap interval (4000 draws, seed 20261017), reported as estimates. A pure depolarizing block gives r_coh / r_pop = 1 and dephasing lowers it; the phase slope is the data qubit's detuning phase over one CZ window plus the CZ's residual local phase on the data qubit
preregistered.walks: <X_c> = omega = -1 on both walks, 0 on both omit-last controls and 0 in Y. Falsifier: sign opposite to omega at |z| > 3, or a control's |<X_c>| above 0.1 + 3 sigma. Cross-prediction: sqrt(<X_c>^2 + <Y_c>^2) equals r^n_CZ for T0's r = 0.9654, 0.810 on the star and 0.869 on the path, within 0.1; the phase atan2(<Y_c>, -<X_c>) is reported
preregistered.replication: the depth-5 and depth-9 bright edge populations per pair against T0's values on the same pair and depth, reported as drift over the hours between the series
preregistered.stop_rule: each batch: every job completed with the manifest's shots; circuit digests equal cases.json; the account's queue empty; a 120 s pause before the next batch. At each readout bracket: readout-0 P1 at most 0.10 and readout-1 P1 at least 0.80 on every used qubit, and no used qubit's e01 or e10 moved more than 0.02 since the previous bracket; a failure stops the series. Every depth-1 deterministic LCU replica within 0.3 of its ideal raw P(selector = 0), and a walk read in X at raw P(c = 1) at least 0.7; every idle qubit at P1 at most 0.15 above its interpolated readout-0 P1
